Item.Name: S_EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Scan equipment bar code, or enter 'M' for manual entry.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := length(temp_start_code);
 if :s_equipment_type = 'M' then
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if length(:s_equipment_type) != 6 + length(temp_start_code) + length(temp_end_code) then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 1, temp_len),'nullx') != nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equipment_type, 7 + temp_len, length(temp_start_code)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx') then
 :s_equipment_type := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- check and see if a valid equipment reference number
--
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1336');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- check and see if authorized to make edits for equipment of this type
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs ea, equipment e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and ea.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and ea.equip_type = e.equip_type
 and e.equip_reference= 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- check to see if reference number has a qc with an "I" status.
--
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from equip_qc_hdr qc
 where qc.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and qc.qc_status = 'I'
 and :banner.user_id != qc.qc_tech_1
 and :banner.user_id != qc.modified_by;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1340');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- set all ctrl blk values.

 begin
 select e.equip_type, substr(m.code_desc,1,13), e.equip_id, e.equip_reference
 into :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_type, :CTRL_BLK_1.s_equip_desc, :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_id,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e, equip_master_codes m
 where e.equip_reference = 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equipment_type, temp_len + 1, 6)
 and m.code = e.equip_type
 and m.code_type = 'EQUIP';
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('EQUIPMENT_REFERENCE');
 execute_trigger ('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 end if;
end;

declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type is not null) then
--
-- see if a valid type of equipment
--
 begin 
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,14)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_equip_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- see if user is authorized to enter data on equipment of this type
--
 begin
 select 'X' 
 into :global.x
 from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs e
 where f.appl_id = 'DON'
 and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id)
 and e.fcn_grp = f.grp_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and v_local_date between e.eff_date and nvl(e.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1302');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- See if a machine of this type exists
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1325');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- see if there is a qc requiring second tech entry for this type of equipment
--
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from equip_qc_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_status = 'I'
 and :banner.user_id != qc.qc_tech_1
 and :banner.user_id != qc.modified_by
 and qc.equip_reference in
 (select e.equip_reference 
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1339');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 else
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if(:qc_hdr.qc_date is null) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_local_date ;
 end if;
 
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:qc_hdr.qc_date, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 
 if(:qc_hdr.qc_date > v_local_date ) then
 show_error ('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if(:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is null) then
 begin
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
-- See if a valid result in equip_master_codes
--
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,12)
 into :qc_hdr.result_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'QCRES'
 and mc.code = :qc_hdr.qc_result_2
 and mc.code not in ('S', 'C', 'I')
 and v_local_date between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
-- if review of detail information, then validate that no unaceptable details exist.
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and qc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and review_code = '2D'
 and v_local_date between qc.eff_date and nvl(qc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 = 'A') then
 validate_qc_result_2;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

 v_local_time date;
begin
 begin

 where mc.code_type = 'QCTYP'

--

 -- 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then

 end if;
 --
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 select substr(det.qc_item,1,24), substr(det.qc_units,1,8)
 into :qc_det.s_qc_description, :qc_det.s_qc_descriptor
 from equip_qc_ctrl det
 where det.qc_id = :qc_det.qc_id
 and det.ref_number = :qc_det.ref_number;
---
 if (mod(:qc_det.arrange_by ,100) > 0) then
 :qc_det.repeat_result := 'R';
 end if;
--
-- if only review of header information, then populate the description fields with the appropriate value
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and qc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and review_code = '2H'
 and v_local_date between qc.eff_date and nvl(qc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,12) into :qc_det.s_qc_interp
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'QCRES'
 and mc.code = :qc_det.interpretation;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-PRVBLK

 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 validate_qc_det;
 check_package_failure;

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:

 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if (:SYSTEM.cursor_record = '1') then
 show_error ('1700');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 up;
 exception when form_trigger_failure then null;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_QC_DET
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_QC_DET IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.det_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 WHILE (:QC_DET.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 if (:QC_DET.interpretation_2 is null) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.det_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_QC_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE assign_qc_status IS
BEGIN
--
-- see if descrepancy in hdr
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is not null) then
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 != :qc_hdr.qc_result_1) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := 'D';
 else
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := :qc_hdr.qc_result_2;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- see if discrepancy in detail;
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_id = :qc_hdr.qc_id
 and qc.review_code = '2D';
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is not null) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.det_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 WHILE (:QC_DET.ref_number is not null) LOOP
 if (:qc_det.interpretation != :qc_det.interpretation_2) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_status := 'D';
 end if;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.det_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;

--
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,50) into :qc_hdr.status_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = :qc_hdr.qc_status;
--

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_QC_RESULT_2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_qc_result_2 IS
BEGIN
 if (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('qc_det');
 :GLOBAL.cursor_record := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:SYSTEM.last_record != 'TRUE') loop
 down;
 end loop;
--
-- search from bottom up for any unacceptable results without a subsequent "A" status on the same ref number.
--
-- check last record
--
 if (:qc_det.interpretation_2 = 'U') then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 if (:system.cursor_record != '1') then
 up;
 end if;
--
-- check all records other than first and last
--
 while (:SYSTEM.cursor_record != '1') loop
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation_2 = 'U') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.ref_number := :qc_det.ref_number;
 up;
 end loop;
--
-- at first record. Check for unacceptable
--
 if ((:qc_det.interpretation_2 = 'U') and (:GLOBAL.ref_number != :qc_det.ref_number)) then
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('1332');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_record (:GLOBAL.cursor_record);
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: COMMIT_QC_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_qc_hdr');
 check_package_failure;
--
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status = 'CHANGED') then
 :qc_hdr.last_modified_date := v_local_date;
 :qc_hdr.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :qc_hdr.program_id := 'EQIQC2';
 end if;
--
 assign_qc_status;
 check_package_failure; 
---
--- Reset machine status to DOWN if QC result is unacceptable, and no subsequent QC of same 
--- type is acceptable
---

 --
 if :qc_hdr.qc_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:qc_hdr.qc_date,v_gmt_time);
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_gmt_time;
 end if; 
 end if;
 --
 
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2= 'U') then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equip_qc_hdr eqh
 where eqh.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and eqh.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and eqh.qc_date > :qc_hdr.qc_date
 and eqh.qc_status = 'A';
 exception when no_data_found then null;
 when too_many_rows then :GLOBAL.x := 'X';
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is null) then
 begin
 update equipment e
 set e.status = 'DOWN'
 where e.equip_reference = :qc_hdr.equip_reference
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 25;
 commit;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger ('KEY-CLRFRM');
 show_error ('0000');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_QC_HDR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
--
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

-- check to see if any information has changed
--
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status not in ('CHANGED', 'INSERT')) then
 :GLOBAL.cursor_block := :SYSTEM.cursor_block;
 :GLOBAL.cursor_item := :SYSTEM.cursor_item;
 go_block ('QC_DET');
 if (:SYSTEM.block_status not in ('CHANGED', 'INSERT')) then
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 show_error ('8013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_block (:GLOBAL.cursor_block);
 go_item (:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 end if;
--
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x from equip_master_codes
 where code_type = 'QCTYP'
 and code = :qc_hdr.qc_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_type');
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_tech_2 is null ) then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_tech_2');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_date is null) then
 :qc_hdr.qc_date := v_local_date;
 end if;
--
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('qc_result_2');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- see if any qc_details to view
--
 if (:qc_det.ref_number is not null) then
--
-- if only review of header information, then do not review details
--
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x 
 from equip_qc_ctrl_hdr qc
 where qc.qc_type = :qc_hdr.qc_type
 and qc.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and review_code = '2H'
 and v_local_date between qc.eff_date and nvl(qc.term_date, v_local_date+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x is null) then
 validate_qc_det;
 check_package_failure;
 if (:qc_hdr.qc_result_2 = 'A') then
 validate_qc_result_2;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
